content: {"episode_id":"ep-05034","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229, acknowledging that the required prior authorization was missing. The clinical indication note documents a history of unspecified atrial fibrillation (I48.91) and persistent episodes of palpitations (R00.2) that interfere with daily activities. Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring was ordered for extended ambulatory assessment to evaluate the frequency and burden of arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances. We request reconsideration based on this documented clinical indication."}
